reviews.text: Tweaked my shoulder mid-season and figured I was done. Dr. Marks had me back pressing in a month with a plan that actually made sense. No fluff, no upselling.
reviews.author: Marcus T.

reviews.text: I'd been managing knee pain for two years. One proper assessment found a hip issue nobody else had looked at. I'm running pain-free for the first time in ages.
reviews.author: Priya N.

reviews.text: Treats you like an athlete, not a patient. Explains everything, gives you the work to do, and expects you to do it. Exactly what I wanted.
reviews.author: Dale W.
